assertion_results.text: Bug parsing extracts the Environment / Version section content including the vague text (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: bug-parsing.md, Required sections table: 'Environment / Version | `### **Environment / Version**` | Yes | "Not sure which version — using whatever is deployed on staging."' and a dedicated 'Environment / Version (verbatim)' subsection quoting the same text, noting 'Its content is vague: it gives no version number...'

assertion_results.text: Version resolution determines that no version identifier can be extracted from the vague description (Step 4.5.2)
assertion_results.evidence: version-resolution.md '## 4.5.2 – Extract version from description' checks three patterns (explicit number, product-prefixed, version keyword + number), all 'None', cites the vague-text rule, and concludes '**Result: no version identifier can be extracted.** Skip to 4.5.6.'

assertion_results.text: Version resolution outputs the gap comment: 'Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description — please set manually.' (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: version-resolution.md '## 4.5.6 – Flag gap' rendered comment body: '> Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description — please set manually.' and the ADF payload text node contains the exact same string.

assertion_results.text: The gap comment includes the Comment Footnote (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: version-resolution.md 4.5.6 rendered comment includes '---' then 'This comment was AI-generated by [sdlc-workflow/triage-bug](https://github.com/RHEcosystemAppEng/sdlc-plugins) v0.14.0.'; the ADF payload adds a 'rule' node plus a paragraph with linked 'sdlc-workflow/triage-bug' text, matching the footnote format in plugins/sdlc-workflow/skills/triage-bug/SKILL.md.
